title: Beauty Talks with Miss Supranational Romania 2018 Andreea M. Coman
dek: Andreea M. Coman was crowned Miss Supranational Romania 2018 at the Romanian Info Fashion Festival held on 7th September 2018 as she became the official representative of Romania in Miss Supranational 2018. She succeeds Miss Supranational Romania 2017 Bianca…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Supranational Romania 2018 Andreea M. Coman
paragraphs: Andreea M. Coman was crowned Miss Supranational Romania 2018 at the Romanian Info Fashion Festival held on 7th September 2018 as she became the official representative of Romania in Miss Supranational 2018. She succeeds Miss Supranational Romania 2017 Bianca Tirsin.

From the city of Pitesti, Andreea is 25 years of age. She is currently living in Bucharest, Romania. Andreea is a model who has worked on numerous projects. She used to study law in the Faculty of Law, University of Bucharest. Now Andreea has a Master’s Degree in law and during her free time, she spends time skiing. But before that, Andreea finds time to talk about her dreams, ambitions and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
INTERVIEW
Q. How does it feel to be Miss Supranational Romania 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Supranational 2018?

It is a challenge and a huge responsibility. I always wanted to represent my country Romania in big pageant and now it’s time for it in my life! I am taking the preparations seriousely, never quit gym, but I always find time for my own activities.
Q. What inspired you to the world of pageantry?

When I first started modeling it was through a beauty pageant, I was 17 years old and if I learned something from that experience was that it is not all about having a beautiful face and a nice body, it is all about how you can inspire another people and what feeling you can transmit to them.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Supranational 2018?

I think that in life is important to have goals and the way how you accomplish them should be a pleasant one. Confidence is very important when you want to achieve something and when you believe you can do it you are almost there.
Q. Who is your role model, if any and what values of his or her do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

A strong role model nowadays for my generations is Nadia Murad, human rights activist, kidnnapped and held by Islamic State. I think is very important to inspire people to tolerance, no matter if we are talking about religion, political option or sexual orientation.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
Thinking that life is a surprise and you can never know what is around the corner and that you have to be ready to react and work with what you receive to the greatest things.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

I always used to get lost so easily. I was very curious and I remember how I was enjoying to discover new things. When I was 6 I ended up in the wrong train and that resulted in I arrived in a different city than my parents. They came after me so in the end we spent our summer holiday in another part than we originarly planed.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
My guilty pleasure defenetly is chocolate and pistachio!
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
I think that sharing experiences and knowlege is what made us better people. Right now I am preparing myself to become a professor so I can pass to the next generations what I received.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
Haha! I don’t want to be invisible because I like being surounded by people and meeting new ones.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?
I know that when it comes to dreams one may falter, but the only way to fail is to abandon them.
Q. If you are granted three wishes right now, what would you ask for?
I wish that I could eat as many chocolates and never gaind weight.
I wish that I could understand what animals think.
I wish that every child in this world can go to school because education is what empower us.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?

I would like to thank Angelopedia fans for their support in this beautiful journey that I am taking right now. I am thrilled to know that there are people that are not looking just for outer beauty, but also for what is inside and what we can transmit.

title: Beauty Talks with Miss Earth Australia 2018 Monique Shippen
dek: Miss Earth Australia 2018 Monique Shippen was crowned on 8th September 2018 as she became the official delegate of Australia in the upcoming Miss Earth 2018. Monique is a singer, songwriter, children’s party entertainer and teacher from Sydney with English…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Earth Australia 2018 Monique Shippen
paragraphs: Miss Earth Australia 2018 Monique Shippen was crowned on 8th September 2018 as she became the official delegate of Australia in the upcoming Miss Earth 2018. Monique is a singer, songwriter, children’s party entertainer and teacher from Sydney with English and Filipino descent. A passionate woman about animals, she adopted a koala from the WWF to help in the conservation of Australia’s native wildlife. Monique loves writing and recording songs about her experiences and performing around Sydney. Her Bachelor's degree in music, Masters Degree in secondary teaching and study in early childhood education make her passionate about teaching young children.

In her spare time, she performs as princesses, superheroes and celebrities for children’s parties and loves inspiring children to follow their dreams. She also loves travelling around the world and went to school in France for a couple of months on a cultural exchange program to improve her French. Her favourite holiday was hiking through many of the beautiful national parks in the USA, as nothing beats natural beauty. Growing up near the beaches in Sydney, she understands how important it is to minimise the creation and use of plastics as it harms our marine life.
As she prepares for her international competition, Monique finds time to talk about her dreams, goals and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
INTERVIEW -
Q. How does it feel to be Miss Earth Australia 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Earth 2018?

It feels amazing and I am truly honoured to represent my beautiful country in the Philippines for the final. I could not believe it when they announced my name because it is a dream come true that my voice can now be heard as a true ambassador of the Earth.
Q. What inspired you to the world of pageantry?

Ever since I was a child, my mother and I would watch pageants on the television together. I always looked up to the strong, beautiful and intelligent women, who expressed what they stand for. Pageants are a wonderful platform for women all over the world to exchange culture and thoughts. Candidates are very determined, strong and work hard leading up to pageants to promote their cause, raise awareness and be positive role models.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Earth 2018?

I would like to represent Australia with a gentle nature, down to earth personality and passion. I want to make the most out of this amazing, life changing experience by making new friends from all over the world and hearing about their passions too.
Q. You’re a singer-songwriter as well. Is that a passion that turned into a profession?

Yes. I used to be shy as a child, so learning how to sing and play keyboard when I was 8 years old developed my self confidence. I started performing more and more on stage, which grew my love for singing. I started songwriting when I was 14 years old and did a songwriting course with Erana Clark, the vocal coach from Australian Idol at the time, to express my feelings and experiences through music. I released a 10 track album called ‘Headache’ and a single called ‘Electrifying’ in 2012 which made the semi finalist list of Unsigned Only (2015, 2016) and the International Songwriting Competition (2016).I am now performing all over Sydney and continuing to write more songs which I hope to release soon.
Q. Would you like to talk about your advocacy as the newly crowned Miss Earth Australia 2018 and delegate of Miss Earth 2018?

We are the only creatures in the history of our planet that creates ‘rubbish’. It’s a human thing. In nature, there is no such thing as rubbish. Animals use what they no longer need for different purposes. Australians use 4 billion plastic bags a year and we have one of the highest rates of tree clearing in any developed country. If each individual follows the 5 Rs - RETHINK, REDUCE, REUSE, RECYCLE, RESPECT, we can start by changing our everyday lifestyle in small ways to make a big impact.

As Miss Earth Australia 2018, I wish to educate children about plastic and food waste by visiting schools and teaming up with groups at university to approach businesses in making environmentally friendly choices (go plastic free, use alternatives). I am reducing my plastic usage by using my own reusable cutlery, straws, lunch containers, bags and cups. I also have a compost at home to reduce food waste and grow some of my own vegetables. My mission is to participate in as many tree planting and clean up days as possible, to purify the air and provide homes for animals affected by deforestation. I also want to volunteer at wildlife parks, use my music networking to host charity events to promote awareness and encourage the local community to get involved.
Q. Who is your role model, if any, and what values of his or her do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

My role model is my mother. She is a strong woman who told me that nothing is impossible if you keep trying your hardest and to never give up on my dreams. She is always supportive and very nurturing which I believe are qualities you need as a role model. She also taught us to appreciate the little things in life and always be thankful. She would tell us stories about the small village she grew up in as a child and how they would make use of what they had by reusing and repurposing. I would love to teach the next generation that we must be determined to work together to nurture our Earth and be thankful for the beautiful resources around us, instead of taking much more than we need and wasting it.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?

The one thing that keeps me going is that I managed to overcome the challenging years of being shy by putting myself out there, following my dreams and not turning back. I am so lucky to have a supportive family who has always been there for me and encouraged me to be the best I can be. But looking back to ‘little me’ and seeing how far I’ve come and everything I have achieved since then inspires me to teach others that anything is possible.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

I have so many special childhood memories because I come from a very close family. The day my brother was born, I will never forget because I was beyond excited to have a friend. We are still best friends now and have so many funny and amazing experiences together as kids. The most special would have to be the camping trips we used to go on around Australia. My parents would take turns driving all day while my brother and I would sing loudly in the backseat. Then we would set up the tent as a family, go for a swim at beach, go for walks in the bush, cook dinner and watch the stars.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
If I was invisible for a day, I would love to take all the plastic straws, bags, containers and forks from as many shops as possible and replace them with friendlier alternatives!
As a singer/songwriter, I would also love to follow Taylor Swift or Katy Perry for a day and see how they write songs, record music videos or get ready for performances.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?

My parents empower me to be myself because they are always very encouraging. I work hard every day because I want to make them proud and do the best that I can with the education they provided me. I have always been a very busy person, juggling study, work, singing and a social life, but feel very rewarded afterwards knowing what I have accomplished. If I know that what I do can change lives of people, I am happy to put everything I have into it. As a teacher, I feel very rewarded everyday, seeing my students grow.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
Eating lots of different cheeses and chocolate while watching Netflix all day in bed. Unfortunately, I do not get to do this a lot anymore. I also love watching children’s movies and TV shows.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?

Winning Miss Earth Australia 2018 is an amazing achievement that I will remember for the rest of my life. I want to be able to make a big difference by working with local communities and teach our future generations how to look after our Earth.

In terms of my career, I am working very hard to become a well known singer/songwriter. I want to focus on writing and recording music that reflects my experiences, but also that people can relate to.
In terms of my personal life, I would love to have my own children one day because I have always loved children and have so much love to give! Family is very important to me.
Q. If you are granted three wishes right now, what would you ask for?
1-I would ask that despite our differences in the world (culture, beliefs, race etc) that everyone gets along with each other with respect (no more wars or terrorism)
2- For us to live in a sustainable environment, everyone has the knowledge and tools to be respectful to the Earth and wildlife around us - living as environmentally friendly as possible
3- A role model as a well known singer and motivational speaker
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?

I would like to say thank you to all of my fans who have given me love and support from all over the world, it means a lot! I will do my best on this amazing experience and make my country, Australia proud. No matter what happens, I will always be woman of the Earth and come out of this as a winner because of all the knowledge I will gain from hearing about the other girls’ advocacies. If you would like to follow my Instagram it is moniquecharlotte_ and you can listen to my music online at officialmonami.comMaramingsalamat! See you in the Philippines!!

title: In Conversation with Miss Grand South Africa 2018 Misha Christie
dek: Miss Grand South Africa 2018 finale was held on 4th August 2018 in Pretoria where Misha Christie emerged as the winner and was crowned Miss Grand South Africa 2018. She will now represent South Africa in the 6th edition of Miss Grand International beauty…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: In Conversation with Miss Grand South Africa 2018 Misha Christie
paragraphs: Miss Grand South Africa 2018 finale was held on 4th August 2018 in Pretoria where Misha Christie emerged as the winner and was crowned Miss Grand South Africa 2018. She will now represent South Africa in the 6th edition of Miss Grand International beauty pageant to be held in Myanmar on 25th October 2018.

Misha, who is a graduate in business management, also won most of the special awards announced during the finale - Public Choice, Best Bikini Body, Best Swimsuit, Best National Costume, Best Evening Gown, Miss Photogenic, and Miss Debutante. As she prepares for her competition, she finds time to talk to us about her dreams, ambitions, childhood and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview.
INTERVIEW
Q. How does it feel to be crowned Miss Grand South Africa 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Grand International 2018?
I am truly blessed and grateful for this opportunity. It is a dream come true, after working so hard towards the Miss Grand South Africa 2018 title. I am more motivated and determined than ever.
Q. What is the best lesson you have learned in your journey as the delegate of Miss Grand South Africa 2018?
That everything happens in God’s time and not ours.
Q.What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
My love for life keeps me going and my compassion for others inspires me to be the best version of myself.
Q. You also won most of the special awards at the finale of Miss Grand South Africa 2018. How did that feel?
It’s an incredible yet emotional feeling.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Grand International 2018?
As a confidently beautiful young woman with strong norms and values.
Q. Who is your ideal, if any and what values of theirs do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

Most definitely Bruce Lee, he has always been one of my biggest inspirations as his life story is such a touching and humbling one. I believe we share the same perseverance and ambition in life by giving our absolute best to reach our goals. No matter how many set backs one receives in life, quitting should not be an option. As Bruce Lee inspires me I hope to inspire others by the legacy I leave behind one day.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
I would spend the day trying to figure out how not to be invisible.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?
The day my brother was born.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?
My family, they believe in my abilities and push me to be a better version of myself each day.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
For me, nothing beats a freshly baked bread straight out of the oven.
Q. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
To have a positive, lasting impact in the world. To leave behind a legacy that inspires, not by who I am, but by the things I did for others. Ultimately, I want to live a meaningful life.
Q. If you are granted 3 wishes right now, what would you ask for?
Firstly, that there would be no hate in the world, only love to give. Secondly, that all the suffering will end, and lastly I wish for everyone to be happy.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?
Never take anything for granted, there are people out there that wish they could live the life you live or have the things that you have. Be grateful, kind and love more, the world needs it.

title: Beauty Talks with Miss Earth Hungary 2018 Réka Lukács
dek: (Photo credit: Bence Panyoki Dress: Renata Rabocsi)
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Earth Hungary 2018 Réka Lukács
paragraphs: (Photo credit: Bence Panyoki Dress: Renata Rabocsi)

Miss Earth Hungary 2018 Réka Lukács is all set to represent Hungary in Miss Earth 2018. The 25-year-old gorgeous diva calls herself a passionate woman with lots of dreams and life-changing plans ahead. Growing up and living in several parts of Hungary, she most definitely knows her country.

Réka has two different sides to her; the artist and the economist. Over the past four years, she established herself as a serious actor. She has placed acting as her most important goal since it has always been her biggest passion in life. She keeps studying the craft so that she can develop her skills in order to get more serious international roles in film and television.

But let’s not forget that she has a “business woman” side as well. She got her university diploma in International Economics. She studied everything in English to perfect her language skills but she also went abroad to study Marketing and Business in Madrid in a Spanish language program. She really has an international flavour.
As the humble queen prepares for her delegation, she finds time to talk about her dreams, ambitions and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
INTERVIEW
Q. Tell us something about yourself and what you have been upto since your crowning?

I had the amazing opportunity to spend the last three months in Los Angeles visiting all sorts of people and places especially Hollywood. I’ve visited California twice and each time I’ve been able to meet a ton of people in the LA film and television industry. One of my friends from the movie industry introduced me to a theater group in Hollywood and I got to be involved in a small stage production. It was all volunteer, unpaid acting of course, but it was an amazing opportunity to practice and felt amazing to act on stage in the “big Hollywood”. It was a good few months because it really got me going as I got to see how Hollywood works.
Q. How does it feel to be Miss Earth Hungary 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Earth 2018?

I am thrilled, honoredz and very very excited. I can’t express how grateful and proud I am about wearing the Miss Earth Hungary 2018 title. It’s such an honor and amazing feeling to represent my country second time in my life in a prestigious world competition. I can’t wait to visit the breathtaking Philippines and participate in the pageant.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Earth 2018?

I will represent Hungary with respect and humility. I will provide my best to make my country proud. I will give myself all the time, enjoy every minute, make new friendships and create lifelong memories.
Q. What inspired you to the world of pageantry?

I have been always admired by these strong, independent women who have the courage, self-confidence and commitment to participate in a competition like Miss Earth. Because its very challenging, you have to be not just beautiful but very smart, strong, dedicated and outstanding. You have to have the power and courage to use your word to be able to draw people’s attention for a good cause. I just call these women as “Wonder Woman” and I always wanted to be one of them. This is happening now so I am very excited.
Q. As a Miss Earth official delegate, what is your advocacy towards environment protection?

We all know, water is essential for life. Without water there is nothing in the world there is no life. However, many people take it for granted and we don’t conserve and protect it. I would like to draw people’s attention to conserve as much as we can and use our joint power to help those people who don’t have access to clean drinking water at all. Millions of people dying because of dirty water or because of drying out when other people live In the biggest prosperity is something I just can’t accept in life. People, we must do something together with joint power against it.
Q. You’re also studying acting for Film from a reputed institution. Would you like to tell us more about this?

For me, since my childhood, acting was always part of my life but after 2014 I was taking it very seriously as I came to realize it was my dream and this is what I would like to do as my profession in the future.

Learning ’acting for film’ at GTC International Film School in Budapest was also a great experience for me. I had four, very amazing and talented actors and directors from Hungary teaching us in a very small class. This school gave me lots of possibilities to meet and collaborate with foreign directors as well who visited to produce and shoot short films in English. Working in English was a whole new challenge!

I started taking more private classes too with very great actors/teachers from Hungary, for example Zsolt Anger and Vica Kerekes. These private classes were so demanding! My teachers and instructors really pushed me to find my own connections to acting roles. At the same time he was really encouraging, allowing me fail as I learned to express emotions, and really get into character roles. In fact acting classes are the place you want to fail, to get it totally wrong so you can find that right voice and right expression. Acting is really about connecting to an inside feeling or emotion and then holding onto it as you engage your role.

It is very motivating and inspiring to me seeing that, lots of famous actors actually started as beauty queens - Gal Gadot is the most recent and famous but Halle Berry and Eva Longoria were both famous American actresses who started out in pageants.
Q. Who is your role model, if any, and what values of his or her do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

My closest role model and superhero is my mother, she is the strongest woman I know she taught my sister and me to never give up in our dreams, and we can reach everything in life if we believe and work hard for our dreams. she supports us in everything. She treats people equally, and teaches us to always stay humble and grateful for what we have in life. I think gratitude is very important for being happy in life and succeed. We cant take anything for granted.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?

If I have to tell one thing that is: Gratitude. I think there is something like “lucky” in life then I am a very lucky women.. because I wake up look at my family my, loved ones, all the amazing people, friends around me, memories, my dreams all the amazing things I experienced and I have been through and I feel enormous gratitude for everything and this is what keeps me going this feels me with energy, happiness and positivity and this feeling inspires me to do more and keep going because life is beautiful and the limit is the sky.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?

That’s not an easy question, my first thought of course was to help people under very poor and bad circumstances by taking money away from dishonest people who get the money illegally or by doing bad things. I would give that money to people in need. However I have no right to judge people like this so I wouldn’t use that power for this.

Because I love acting and my biggest dream is to be an amazing international actress and get serious roles in big Hollywood movies too. So I would spend half of that day in a movie shooting and watch every single details. The other half of the day I would spend with Meryl Streep and learn from her by watching how she gets prepared for a serious role.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?

I am extremely blessed by the amazing people around me. Somehow, I always attract very valuable and special people in my life who support and inspire me. I have a wonderful mother and sister, we have very strong relationship they are always next to me. These people and my dedication and passion empower me to work hard and reach all my dreams.
(Photo Credits: Hollywood pictures: Photographer: Andres Martinez)
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

I have plenty of amazing memories but if I have to highlight one is the time when me and my sister could convince mom to buy us a dog and we chose our puppy together. That is a very sweet memory. My dog’s name was Yellow she was a Golden Retriever she just passed away this year. She has been with us for 14 years
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?

Oo My God, I don’t even want to think about that right now. I have very sweet teeth and my favorite guilty pleasure is watching movies or my favorite series while eating my favorite, the best Peanut Butter Cup Ben & Jerry’s Ice cream. Unfortunately I can barely do this because I am always on diet and I don’t have lots of free time. But this is the best thing.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?

The Miss Earth Hungary title goes with lots of amazing opportunity and possibility that’s for sure. First of all I would like to use the publicity and these opportunities to draw people’s attention to good causes by expressing values and good example to the younger generations who will have the power to make changes in the world around us. Regarding my career I would like to focus on acting because I find it exhilarating and challenging. I really love film, I hope to one day be part of movies that inspire and motivate people just like some of my favorite films have inspired and motivated me.
Q. If you are granted three wishes right now, what would you ask for?
I would ask to everyone have the basic conditions for a normal, acceptable life
I want the people to live in peace and harmony and accept and respect each other( no more wars)
To become a role model as an actress
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?

I would like to send lots of hugs from Budapest and say thank you for the support you guys are giving me! It means a lot to me. I can’t wait to be in the Philippines and I am so excited to represent my country. You can follow my journey in the Philippines and my preparation until the pageant on my Instagram page: rekaalu
See you there you are the best!

title: Beauty Talks with Miss Tourism World Philippines 2018 Kathleen Tagle Gomez
dek: Kathleen Tagle Gomez was crowned Miss Tourism World Philippines 2018 on 25th August 2018 at the grand finale of Miss Tourism Philippines 2018 held at Chateau Royale Resort in Batangas. She succeeds Miss Tourism Philippines 2017 Marian Angelu Perez Alcantara…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Tourism World Philippines 2018 Kathleen Tagle Gomez
paragraphs: Kathleen Tagle Gomez was crowned Miss Tourism World Philippines 2018 on 25th August 2018 at the grand finale of Miss Tourism Philippines 2018 held at Chateau Royale Resort in Batangas. She succeeds Miss Tourism Philippines 2017 Marian Angelu Perez Alcantara and will now represent the Philippines in Miss Tourism World 2018.

The gorgeous Filipina loves her family to the core. As a believer, she never forgets her roots and is always grateful for everything she has achieved so far in her life. As Kathleen prepares for her international journey, she talks about her dreams, ambitions and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
INTERVIEW -
Q. How does it feel to be Miss Tourism World Philippines 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Tourism World 2018?
I feel ecstatic and over-whelmed because I never thought I'll be given a chance to represent the whole country of Philippines for Miss Tourism World 2018.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Tourism World 2018?
I would like to represent myself at the international stage of Miss Tourism World 2018 as a Filipina with a strong personality but has a soft heart.
Q. What inspired you to the world of pageantry?

My advocacy and the people who I think that will benefit from it is the thing that inspired me to the world of pageantry. I would love to promote my advocacy which focuses mainly on the emotional well-being of the people specifically, depression.
Q. Who is your role model, if any, and what values of his or her do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

My role model will be Oprah Winfrey. She is an embodiment of a strong woman. A woman who has been through a lot of struggles but still manages to stand and pick herself up, and to be a successful woman globally. I want to be like her that in spite of all the struggles in life, she still became successful and was able to inspire a lot of people through her story. I want the next generation to have her personality traits as being strong and a fighter for life.
Q. You were also a delegate of Miss World Philippines 2017 where you advocated about the emotional well-being of children. Would you like to tell us about your advocacy?

My advocacy when I joined Miss World 2017 was about the emotional wellbeing of the children, focuses mainly on the Abuse. Giving them proper care and guidance through psychiatric matters and/or providing them proper homes they deserve to have. But now, I really want to focus on something that more of us will benefit from it, not only the younger ages but rather all of the ages and this is about depression. Depression has been rampant nowadays. A lot of people suffered from it and a lot lives have been taken because of it. As a beauty queen, I really want to take a big part of that change. I want to provide them proper emotional guidance they will need to conquer it.
Q. It’s a well-believed notion and rightly so, that The Philippines is a hub of pageant queens and winners. Does that add more pressure to give a good performance?
It has always been a pressure to everyone to do great in the world of pageantry. Of course, every one of us wanted to feel well-deserved on the title that is given to us.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
If I could be invisible for a day, I would like to spend it by seeing the people who truly care about me, the ones who will genuinely cry for me if I will be gone.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

My most special childhood memory was playing the old-time Filipino games like piko, tumbrang press, luksong baka and more. I am proud to say that at least I have given a chance to play these kind of games before because children nowadays focus on the virtual world of games.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?
What empowers me the most is my family. I really wanted to make them proud of me.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
My guilty pleasure will be eating seafood. I am allergic to it but it is my favourite. So how can I resist?
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
My main goal now is to at least win the title of Miss Tourism World 2019 for the whole Philippines.
Q. If you are granted three wishes right now, what would you ask for?

If I will be granted three wishes right now, that will be, first is having a lifetime with my family. I do not want them to be dead. I really want to spend forever with them, specially with my parents. Second will be world peace. I hope wars will be ended and no more lives will be taken. And lastly, cure for all the sickness so that people who have limited life line will be able to spend more time with their families and loved-ones.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?

It has been an honor for me to be supported by such talented people from Angelopedia. I really want you guys to be more proud of me if I have given a chance to at least win the title of Miss Tourism World 2019. I love you! Please continue to support me on my journey.
Well we love you too Kathleen! All the best for your upcoming endeavors!

title: Beauty Talks with Miss Universe Ireland 2018 Grainne Gallanagh
dek: Grainne Gallanagh was crowned Miss Universe Ireland 2018 on 2nd August 2018 to become the official representative of Ireland in the upcoming Miss Universe 2018. A science graduate and a nurse by profession, she enjoys working with others and helping those in…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Universe Ireland 2018 Grainne Gallanagh
paragraphs: Grainne Gallanagh was crowned Miss Universe Ireland 2018 on 2nd August 2018 to become the official representative of Ireland in the upcoming Miss Universe 2018. A science graduate and a nurse by profession, she enjoys working with others and helping those in need. Female health and empowerment are particularly important to Grainne. She believes in using her voice and Miss Universe Ireland platform to raise awareness about women’s health.
As Grainne prepares to represent her country in Miss Universe 2018, she finds time to talk about her dreams, ambitions, childhood and her guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
INTERVIEW –
Q. How does it feel to be Miss Universe Ireland 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Universe 2018?

It feels amazing. It is very surreal, it feels almost like an outer body experience. I have always admired all of the contestants and winners of Miss Universe and to actually be one now fills me with an immense sense of pride. I am extremely honoured and grateful to represent my beautiful country on an international stage.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Universe 2018?

I hope to be the best version of myself that I can be. I will not change who I am as a person, my authenticity is what makes me and it differentiates me from everyone else. I will keep my own personal traits, my passion and determination. In saying that, I think we all need a bit of humour to keep everything lots of fun.
Q. What inspired you to the world of pageantry?

I love pageants. I love everything that they stand for. I have always admired the MU contestants. I love how they represent an honest portrayal of women, that women can be beautiful and still intelligent. We do not have to be one-dimensional characters. I love the fact that pageants give a good platform for important issues and topics and allow women to bring some of these deserving issues and charities to light.
Q. We have heard that you would want to use your platform to raise awareness about women health, why would you like to talk about that?

I am very passionate about women’s health issues. This really is the time for women to shine. There are finally issues about the treatment women that are being highlighted in society. I am a qualified nurse and female health is very close to my heart. As my time as Miss Universe Ireland, I hope to raise awareness about preventable diseases that affect women. I want to give women a sense of empowerment in terms of their health and have the confidence to say when they feel that something is not right.
Q.Who is your role model, if any, and what values of his or her do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

My role model in life is without a doubt my mother. She is a fantastic woman and human being. I have been very lucky that my parents are so supportive of everything that I do. She has taught me many things, one of the most important I would say has been patience and kindness. She has 5 daughters and 4 grandchildren and she is always there for us, no matter what. She has always been patient and showed us to treat everyone with kindness no matter who they are or where they come from. It is something that I would like to continue to do and show the next generation that you don’t need to be cruel to get ahead in life.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?

My motivation to keep going is my family. My parents have tried to give me the best start in life and I strive to make them proud of me. I have 5 sisters and they are always helping me and giving me life advice and they continuously inspire me to be the best version of myself.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
If I could be invisible I would go to the airport and travel so as many countries as I could possibly squeeze in! Imagine travelling to loads of exotic places for free!
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

My favourite childhood memory has to be my summers at the beach. I live beside the coast and it might not seem exciting to some people but my favourite memories are spending every day at the beach with my family. We would just spend all day everyday if It was sunny or raining, swimming in the sea and having picnics. Even to this day swimming in the sea always makes me feel relaxed and happy.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?

My family is my inspiration to be myself. They empower me to be who I am and be confident in what I believe. I feel like my dreams motivate me to work hard because I know I need to push myself out of my comfort zone and face my fears if I want to achieve my goals
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?

My guilty pleasure is a bar of chocolate, a glass of wine and sitting in front of Netflix. There is nothing like better than getting home after a long day and relaxing with chocolate and wine in front of a good film.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
Apart from being the first ever Irish Miss Universe? I hope to open my own women’s health clinic in my local area to help women in my community.
Q. If you are granted three wishes right now, what would you ask for?
1. That I could win Miss Universe, and bring the crown to my country for the first time and shine a light on female healthcare.
2. To find a cure for incurable diseases such as cancer and HIV
3. End world hunger
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?
I would just like to say thank you so much for all your continued support from the bottom of my heart. I hope to do everyone proud at Miss Universe and appreciate every single message of support!

title: Beauty Talks with Miss Earth Canada 2018 Jaime Yvonne VandenBerg
dek: At the finale of Miss Earth Canada 2018 held on 11th August 2018, Jaime Yvonne VandenBerg was crowned the new queen. Jaime will now represent Canada in the upcoming Miss Earth 2018. Born and raised in the Windy City of Lethbridge, Alberta, Jaime Vanderberg’s…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Earth Canada 2018 Jaime Yvonne VandenBerg
paragraphs: At the finale of Miss Earth Canada 2018 held on 11th August 2018, Jaime Yvonne VandenBerg was crowned the new queen. Jaime will now represent Canada in the upcoming Miss Earth 2018. Born and raised in the Windy City of Lethbridge, Alberta, Jaime Vanderberg’s list of special talent and training are Runway, Photography, Acting, Public Speaking, Mixed Martial arts, Gymnastics, Belly Dancing, Singing, and Percussion and Piano. Jaime has been volunteering since she was young and believes that with determination and passion anything can happen and anyone can make a difference.
As Jaime prepares to represent her country at Miss Earth 2018, she finds time to talk about her dreams, ambitions and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
Q. How does it feel to be crowned Miss Earth Canada 2018and now a delegate of Miss Earth2018?
It feels so surreal to be the new Miss Earth Canada! This will be my first time competing in an international pageant so I hope I make a positive impact wile representing my country.
Q. What is the best lesson you’ve learnt in your journey as the delegate of Miss Earth Canada 2018?

The best lesson I’ve learnt, as a delegate of Miss Earth Canada 2018, is that the best way to make the most out of a pageant is to use the title to make a difference. Sometimes good things come to those who wait but, great things come to those who work hard and strive for excellence.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?

One thing that keeps me going and inspires me to be the best version of myself is to remember what I am representing with my title. If I want to do the best I can, I need to be in the best shape I can, both body and mind. It is important to live a well-balanced live style in order to maintained focused on your goals.
Q. You also won Miss Teen Alberta pageant. How did your passion for pageants stem at a young age?

My passion for pageants grew when I began meeting so many other young women who were as motivated as I was. I felt like I didn’t fit in well with my high school friends, so after I met a few girls in the first pageant it grew my confidence level. Pageants helped me to realize that long distant friendships are some of the best and can last a lifetime!
Q . How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Earth 2018?
I would like to represent myself for exactly who I am honest, humble, and kind. I am unapologetically myself and I hope I make my country proud.
Q. We have also heard you have done a lot of social service throughout the globe. Would you like to tell us something about that?

I have done a beach clean up in Costa Rica, a silent protest with an indigenous rights group in San Clemente and I helped build a school in a tribal village in India. I volunteer quite a bit in Canada as well but since I love travelling I try to give back to some of the places I visit. Volunteering in other countries is a great way to connect with the community there and learn more about the culture.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?

If I could be invisible for a day, I would spend it by visiting government offices or city council meetings so that I could hear why some environmental actions are not being taken. In my community, the blue bin idea has been around for a while but it continually is not being put into effect. Several other surrounding communities have a black bin, a blue bin and a green bin to separate garbage, recycling and compost at residential homes. I am very interested in finding out why my community has not yet made the change.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

My most special childhood memory would be a compilation of all of the road trips we had taken together. Since my father owns an RV dealership he would often buy new units from the United States and as a family, we would drive them back making a vacation out of the trip. It was a great growing up learning the importance of balancing family, work and fun.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?

I believe the strongest king of motivation is self- motivation. I empower my self by being grateful for the life I was given and understanding that there is so much inequality in the world. I want to make the most out of my life and I strongly believe that helping others is how I can achieve that. Weather it is illness or loosing your job any one's life can take a turn in the road and all we can do is come together as a community to help others in need.
Q.Who is your ideal, if any and what values of theirs do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

My idol is Darcy James; she is the director of the Victim Services Unit at the Lethbridge police station. Darcy was the first woman police officer in Lethbridge and worked in the force for 30 years before moving on to work the Victim Services Unit. Darcy teaches the volunteers how to handle crisis situation with such great passion and fire. It is so inspiring to see some one do what they love despite the obstacles they have had to over come in order to make a difference in their community. I believe it is very important to be passionate about what you do in order to reach your full potential and live a happy life. I would teach the next generation that money can’t buy happiness, many people chose their occupation based on the income it will give but if you are spending a great deal of your life working that job wouldn’t you rather do something you enjoy?
Q.What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
My guilty pleasure is mac and cheese. It is my absolute favourite comfort food!
Q.We are sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?

I ultimately want to achieve a true purpose in life. I think many people like my self who volunteer and put themselves out there are actively trying to make a difference in the world. It is important to do many things in life in order to find out what your best at. I believe doing what your best at will give you a sense of fulfillment and purpose.
Q. If you were granted 3 wishes right now, what would you ask for?

If I was granted 3 wishes right now, I would ask for a solution to reverse the climate change we have experienced, an opportunity to present the solution to the officials that could make it happen and the ability to create fresh water by the snap of my fingers.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?

To the fans of Angelopedia, thank you for your support. With out the support of family and friends, I would not be where I am and I am forever grateful for this opportunity to represent my country. I truly believe in the message behind Miss Earth, that we can all make a difference and we can protect mother Earth. By making even the smallest changes in an individuals lifestyle we can create a lasting environmental impact. So, thank you for inspiring me to use my beauty to advocate for change.

Q. How does it feel to be Miss Supranational Paraguay 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Supranational 2018?

It is such a dream come true for me, I am very excited about being Miss Supranational Paraguay 2018 because I feel I would be able to represent my country in the best possible way and inspire as much people I can.
Q. What inspired you to the world of pageantry?
Honestly, It always called my atention, since I was a little girl I use to watch every year the competitions worldwide, the dresses, the girls, the performance of every single one of them.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Supranational 2018?
As a real and honest woman who is true to herself, loving her country and trying to be the very best version of role model and kind person.

He is such a nice human being and an amazing pilot, I always looked up to be like that, since I was a little girl we talked about planes, he will take my to the cockpit to show me everything, he inspires me more and more everyday.

Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
That we are not perfect but we are here to learn and be better.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

The first time I traveled with my family by plane, it was the most amazing experience of all times, my dad was the captain and me and mom and my sister were with all the passengers in the back, we went to the beach.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?
My family, I love them so much I can’t even describe it.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
Probably going shopping hahaha!
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
Having an amazing cup of coffee in the afternoon with a few good friends.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
Be someone who inspire people for good, be always genuine and honest, brave and kind.
Q. If you are granted three wishes right now, what would you ask for?
Health for every single one of us, never be in need of love, and the courage to persuade our dreams always.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?
Believe always in yourself and never be afraid to show how you are because you are amazing just like that, everything is possible.

title: Beauty Talks with Miss World Armenia 2018 Arena Zeynalian
dek: Arena Zeynalian was crowned Miss Armenia 2018 on 8th July 2018 by her predecessor Miss Armenia 2017 Lily Sargsyan. From Tehran, the 24-year-old Arena surpassed 19 other participants at the finale. Arena also received the title of Miss Solidarity, Miss Hayuhi…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss World Armenia 2018 Arena Zeynalian
paragraphs: Arena Zeynalian was crowned Miss Armenia 2018 on 8th July 2018 by her predecessor Miss Armenia 2017 Lily Sargsyan. From Tehran, the 24-year-old Arena surpassed 19 other participants at the finale. Arena also received the title of Miss Solidarity, Miss Hayuhi, and Miss Congeniality Armenia 2018. Arena loves sport, especially fitness.

Arena holds a bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology. All set to represent Armenia at Miss World 2018, Arena finds time to talk about her dreams, ambitions and advocacies in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
Q. How does it feel to be crowned Miss World Armenia 2018 and now a delegate of Miss World 2018?

The requirements needed to be a Miss World contestant back almost 70 years ago are far more different today. Of course it’s an honor to have been elected and represent my nation because I’m the face of my country and of the youth today. Nowadays women are not only beautiful from the outside but more importantly they should be sophisticated in their inner world.
I see the beauty in a person’s manner, statues and attitude as these features I consider true beauty.

As for delegating my duties and representing such a vital position will allow me to set an example for the rest of the younger women of my nation and the rest of the world, saying that you can be both smart , elegant and a person who is worthy.
Q. What is the best lesson you’ve learnt in your journey as the delegate of Miss Armenia 2018?

One of the most crucial aspects that I had the opportunity to learn was that I always misjudged myself and my capabilities. I realized myself worth that I can do anything but still stay humble. I want to set an example to all those beautiful girls who do not see the strength that they have inside them. “Girls let go of your insecurities and be proud of who you are “
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
We all have people that we look up to whether they are from a family or outside of it. Undoubtedly I have one too , actually a few:)

One is of course my mother. Having lost her soul mate she had to per survivor for our sake. Another is famous women who despite her personal tragedies she continued to think about other people and help them when they needed it. This is the beloved princess Diana.
Of course they are many others that are worthy to mention however these two women are my moguls.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss World 2018?
Wow, this is an interesting question:)

Though a difficult one indeed I don’t want to sound too cliche and repetitive but my aim will be to set an example to all those girls out there that anything is possible of you set your mind to it. Who would have thought that a girl like me, born and raised in a very conservative nation and being of a different race and religion and despite all the obstacles that I have faced could be in the position that holds so much honor and respect.
I’m truly blessed even if I don’t win the pageant I feel that I have already won.
Q. Who is your ideal, if any and what values of theirs do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

Having already mentioned my idols, Princess Diana and my mother Elizabeth, it is a privilege to talk more about them and the reason why I adore these women. First of all my mother she has always been the type of woman that I hope to be myself one day, her generosity, willpower and love for life is what has made me be here today. There were times I wanted to give up specially after my father’s passing , my mother’s persistence kept me on track. As for the unforgettable princess Diana I see her as a person of not just extreme external beauty but an inner beauty that will never die her desire to help others, her kindness and generosity as well as being a woman who challenged everything and everyone was what made her so unforgettable.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
To be a person that will not be seen by others will give the opportunity to do thing that no one can. Like disable all the nuclear weapons in this world.
On the personal side and I’m sorry if I’m a little bit selfish, to visit all the secret places in the world. For example sneaking the Vatican archives and read all the art books.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

I’ve been lucky to have had the opportunity to travel with my family and seeing the different cultures of this world. Their heritage, music, food and general history was amazing to see, although I was a little girl I still feel and remember the experience.

I had visited Russia specially Moscow and Saint Petersburg, standing in the middle of the Red Square feeling the power and eating my Prashki :) or visiting Thailand seeing the outrageously beautifully decorated temples and eating at their restaurants will never be forgotten by me.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?

Being a representative of the Armenian race I feel very proud and honored because my people have gone through so much. They struggle for freedom, truth, justice and democracy is truly inspiring. We are small nation of people ,I don’t want to exaggerate but I each one of us are so talented one of these people is my father who was always there for me in person and he is still with me in spirit and pushing me to be the best that I can be.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?

Everybody has a weakness so why shouldn’t I have one?!! I have to confess that I’m not much of an eater :)) but a few months ago I went to an Asian restaurant and I was served smoked duck it was the most delicious thing I have ever eaten, I couldn’t get enough of that duck and 4 weeks in a row I have been eating:))) I later found out it’s name is called “Peikijg Duck.”
And of course I have a weakness for dark Chocolate :))
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
Frankly Speaking, this particular situation that I’m I of course it’s a great honor when I compare it with the other events in my life.

I want to use these statues as a stepping stone to a type of public figure who will represent the voice of the young people, whether in my country or the rest of the world. I want to be the voice that will help bring out the issues that my generation is facing today and for the security of our future. It’s vital that people who are in the same situation as me use this position not just for themselves but for the others.
Q. If you are granted 3 wishes right now, what would you ask for?
There are many wishes that I would like to make so the three wishes are not enough:))

However my first and most important wish has already come true and I’m holding this title. It is a dream of many girls to be in the position that we are all have and hopefully this dream will become one of the most important aspects of my life.
My second wish will sound a little silly.
It is to see or even meet the Backstreet Boys.
They were my idols when I was young and I grew up with their songs.
My final wish may sound a little selfish but I would like a wish that I can wish continue wishing at least once a year. If not then I wish peace for whole world.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?
My message is girls never give up on your dreams, you are beautiful, talented, smart and don’t let anyone say otherwise.
I am proud of you and love you no matter who you are and where you are.

title: Beauty Talks with Miss Intercontinental USA 2018 Syanne Centeno
dek: The 26-year-old Syanne Centeno was crowned Miss Intercontinental USA 2018 on 9th August 2018 and became the official representative of USA at Miss Intercontinental 2018. A true Island girl at heart, Syanne is of Puerto Rican descent and a native of the U.S…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Intercontinental USA 2018 Syanne Centeno
paragraphs: The 26-year-old Syanne Centeno was crowned Miss Intercontinental USA 2018 on 9th August 2018 and became the official representative of USA at Miss Intercontinental 2018. A true Island girl at heart, Syanne is of Puerto Rican descent and a native of the U.S Virgin Islands.

Syanne is the founder of nonprofit organization called Warrior Princess Initiative which aids children with life-threatening diseases. A mental health advocate, Syanne published a book in 2015 on Anorexia Nervosa and is currently studying drug and alcohol counseling. She is a true embodiment of a fighter and a real queen!
As the newly crowned queen prepares for her international competition, she finds time to talk about her dreams, advocacies, goals and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
Q. How does it feel to be crowned Miss Intercontinental USA 2018 and now a delegate of Miss Intercontinental2018?

It is honestly a dream come true. Not only am I representing the United States, but I am also representing my beautiful territories that are a part of the United States, such as the U.S Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico. I am ecstatic to represent the diversity of my country.
Q. What is the best lesson you’ve learned in your journey in the pageant industry?
The best lesson I have learned is to ALWAYS be yourself. Authenticity and transparency is something that the public can relate to, and you never know if your story will inspire someone else.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
My faith in God keeps me going and inspires me to be the best version of myself. I was created on purpose, with a purpose. I am determined to fulfill my divine purpose.
Q. You were a part of the Top 10 delegates at Miss World America 2015. Do you think the experience has taught you anything that you will use as a national crown holder now?
That experience has taught me how to be confident in who I am. Being on stage and feeling beautiful has really shown me that I can do anything that I set my mind to.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Intercontinental 2018?

I would like to represent myself authentically. I have been through difficult adversities. I have survived a suicide attempt. I have survived anorexia nervosa. I have survived bullying. And now here I am, representing the USA. Despite my many struggles, I am proof that you can reach your dreams no matter what you have been through. I would like to represent myself as a symbol of strength.
Q . We have also heard that you are a mental health advocate. Would you like to share your story with us?

When I was an 8 year-old little girl, I was bullied for being different. I came from the U.S Virgin Islands and moved to California (later moved to Maryland at 15 years-old). I had glasses and crooked teeth. I was seen as ugly, and strange. This caused me to develop Anorexia Nervosa at the young age of 8 years old, which lasted until I was about 19. When I was 16, I was hospitalized in an eating disorder clinic. After I was released I was bullied for being in psychiatric care. After this, I attempted suicide. I struggled for many years into my adulthood. Like any illness, you can go into remission and can relapse. I was doing great for several years, and in 2016 I was diagnosed with a very serious (and misunderstood) mental illness called Borderline Personality Disorder. Since then, I have been in partial hospitalization programs twice. They have helped me immensely and I am now in the best state of mind that I have ever been and am proud of who I am—even with my illness. I began advocating for mental health awareness in 2014 with the help of The BULLY Project organization, and later with the Emotions Matter organization—which specifically focuses on bringing awareness to Borderline Personality Disorder.
Q. Who is your ideal, if any and what values of theirs do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

I would say my ideal is Jesus Christ. Jesus was someone in history who is known for His compassion and love for others’, despite their transgressions. I aspire to be as much like Him as possible—seeing past others’ wrongdoings and always acting with love. I would teach the next generation to act with a servant heart as He did.
Q . What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard everyday?
In addition to God, I would say my mother empowers me to work hard and to be myself. She encourages me and builds me up every single day to be the best version of myself.
Q . What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
I absolutely LOVE punk rock music. It is most definitely my guilty pleasure.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
Ultimately, I would like to enact change in how those with mental illness are viewed. We can be anything. Pageant titleholders, counselors, doctors, lawyers, and anything else we set our minds to.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
I would probably spend it going on adventures in hidden places in the wilderness.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

When I was a child, I would go around St. Croix (in the U.S Virgin Islands) and help stray animals with my grandfather. He was amazing. He would rescue dogs from the streets, and when I would visit him, we would take care of them together. He passed away from Alzheimer’s Disease but I will honor his memory by supporting the Alzheimer’s Association next month at the Walk to End Alzheimer’s. I will never forget the incredible work that he did in his community.
Q. If you were granted 3 wishes right now, what would you ask for?
I would ask for mental and physical illness to disappear from the face of the Earth, for humans to act with love, and for suffering of children and animals to dissipate.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?

My final message to those of Angelopedia is to always be YOU. Be who you were created to be, and act with love in everything you do. It may be difficult, but your life (and the lives around you) will change once you choose compassion and love over apathy and hate. I also want to thank you all for your love and support. It is appreciated more than you know.

title: Beauty Talks with Miss International Czech Republic 2018 Daniela Zálešáková
dek: Daniela Zálešáková, the second runner-up at Miss Czech Republic 2017, is Miss International Czech Republic 2018 and will represent Czech Republic at Miss International 2018. The 19-year-old beautiful diva is all set to bring home the coveted crown with her…
author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss International Czech Republic 2018 Daniela Zálešáková
paragraphs: Daniela Zálešáková, the second runner-up at Miss Czech Republic 2017, is Miss International Czech Republic 2018 and will represent Czech Republic at Miss International 2018. The 19-year-old beautiful diva is all set to bring home the coveted crown with her dedicated preparation and sincerity.
As Daniela prepares to represent her country at an international level, she finds time to talk about her dreams, passion and even her guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
Q. How does it feel to be Miss International Czech Republic 2018 and now a delegate of Miss International 2018?

It’s really very big honor to represent my country on such prestigious world competition. I have never imagined anything like that, but now I am one of those women I have watched in tv. I am really proud and grateful for that chance.
Q. What is the best lesson you’ve learnt in your journey as the delegate of Miss Czech Republic 2017?

It was a long way but excellent experience. Best lesson I’ve learnt is make myself better in whatever I want, achieve my goals and move limits. And I met a lot of people, how bad so well, but above all good friends.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
Whatever I do and want, I do the best I can. I have no inspiration; just want to live life to the fullest.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss International 2018?

I would like to represent myself as a confident, strong and humble woman who has come to show the best she has. Also I would like the jurors to appreciate my communication skills, my properties like accountability, that I am aspirant and feel my positive energy.
Q. Who is your ideal, if any and what values of theirs do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

I have no ideal I believe in myself and always try to do the best in my life. I would like to teach next generation to be kind, try to find the best in other people use their power to good and focus to positive energy.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
I have no idea; I like to spend my days with people I love so if I would be invisible it couldn’t be possible to be with them face to face.
7. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

Yes I would like to, some interesting facts, I was absolutely like a boy. I climbed trees, ride a bike, and did karate for 10 years. But I liked barbies, that is normal for girls. Some memory, I had a baby bottle with teat and special pillow in the shape of heart and every morning my dad takes my from bad to living room, made cacao to my bottle and laid me to the pillow, but the funny fact is that it was till my eight years. After cacao he made my hair and dressed me up.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?
I empower myself, I want to live for something, enjoy life, and leave something on this world for my kids and next generations.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
I don't know if I have some guilty pleasure, I have a lot of pleasure but I don’t feel guilty. If we are talking for example about food I really love cakes, all kinds of cakes.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?

If we are talking about this competition I want and will do my best to win this competition. If my dreams come true I would like to use this power for good. I would like to help people, especially kids in backward countries; I would like them to have the opportunity of education and for better life. And about my future personal life, I started study psychology and I would like to use these skills to personal development of people, to help them with their problems, to be better in their life, move their limits and make them feel confident and strong.
Q. If you are granted 3 wishes right now, what would you ask for?
First - be the best in everything I do. Second - try to teach world and people to focus on positive energy, just be happy and Third - to have loving and healthy family.
12. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?
Yes! Thank you for this questions, wish me luck and support me. I will show you my best!

author: Priya Bhardwaj
caption: Beauty Talks with Miss Intercontinental Czech Republic 2018 Veronika Volkeova
paragraphs: Veronika Volkeova (Age – 22 Years) was awarded the title of third runner-up at Miss Czech Republic 2017 and consequently titled Miss Intercontinental Czech Republic 2018. Veronika is a student of geography at Charles University in Prague. With an interest in maps and nature and processes of earth, Veronika also wishes to work with Renewable energy.
Before her international representation, Veronika takes out time to talk about her dreams, ambitions, childhood and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
Q. How does it feel to be Miss Intercontinental Czech Republic 2018 and now a delegate of MissIntercontinental2018?
I am so proud, that I can represent my country in the world. It was my biggest dream to inspire other people, and now I am more visible and I can help to people and things who need it the most.
Q. What is the best lesson you’ve learnt in your journey as the delegate and then the third runner-up of Miss Czech Republic 2017?
This beauty pageant has given me so many experiences. Thanks to our director Tatana Makarenko, who was at many world beauty pageants as a contestant, we have had the best practice.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
My family and the closest friends around me are the best thing that keeps me going.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss Intercontinental 2018?
I would like to show the best of me. I would like to inspire other people and help other people thanks to this beauty pageant.
Q. Who is your ideal, if any and what values of theirs do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?
My ideal is our director because she is so young and she has got so many experiences in this world. She did a lot in her life, for her beauty pageant, so she really inspires me.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
I would go far away from my country, to see another place and culture. I can’t do this right now, because it is so expensive to travel the world.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?

Most of my special memories comes from the times, when I was at children’s camp. There was no electricity, no shower, nothing. We slept in tents and we had to make food by yourself. I learnt a lot of things there and I had a chance to know, how hard is a life for children in poor countries.
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?
Just myself, because I want to be the best and only I can do this. My mind is the most important and it empowers me the most.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
It is not hard to label one thing. It is definitely nachos with cheese sauce.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?

To this day, my biggest achievement was being 3rd runner up in Miss Czech Republic. But I want always the most. I would like to be a part of Miss Intercontinental whole year that is my biggest dream right now.
Q. If you are granted 3 wishes right now, what would you ask for?

The first one is, I want that every person on this planet could be happy and healthy. The second one is, that there won’t be any wars in the world. And the last one is, that if our environment could be more clear.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?
I am so happy, that you can meet me closer thanks to this interview. I hope, that you will like me and that you will support me in my way to Miss Intercontinental 2018.

caption: Beauty Talks with Miss World Czech Republic 2018 Kateřina Kasanová
paragraphs: Katerina Kasanová, the winner of Miss Czech Republic 2017, is all set to represent her country at the upcoming Miss World 2018 pageant as Miss World Czech Republic 2018. A model by profession, this beauty stands tall at 177 cm. With her gorgeous looks and the determination to bring home the coveted Miss World crown, she has already mesmerized everyone around the world.
In midst of all her training and preparations, Katerina finds time to talk about her dreams, ambitions, childhood and guilty pleasures in an exclusive interview with Angelopedia.
Q. How does it feel to be Miss World Czech Republic 2018 and now a delegate of Miss World 2018?
I am ready to represent my country with all the love and humbleness I've got.
Q. What is the best lesson you’ve learnt in your journey as the delegate and winner of Miss Czech Republic 2017?

That one individual can really make changes in this world. With Miss Czech Republic i did get a lot of attention on my person, which transferred to social media. If used with well, its a great tool to voice our opinions way louder than before and that is my plan.
Q. What is the one thing that keeps you going and inspires you to be the best version of yourself?
The fact that i can be someone's role model or simply help other people or beings is definitely a great motivation.
Q. How would you like to represent yourself at the international stage of Miss World 2018?
I believe I was chosen as Miss CR17 for being natural, kind and humble. That is how i want to represent myself and my country.
Q. Who is your ideal, if any and what values of theirs do you wish you could inculcate in your own life, and teach the next generation?

There are many wise people with values i respect. Some of those people left very powerful quotes that helped me shape my life.. But i would not jump the gun to teach next generations by values of others, i still have to live my life, have my own failures and my own victories to learn from and shape who i am before i would dare to teach others.
Q. If you could be invisible for a day, how would you like to spend it?
That seems like playing God ... nothing good usually comes from it, i would skip that.
Q. Would you like to share your most special childhood memory with us?
When I was three years old my grandpa told me... "I know my sunshine, that one day you will have blond long hair and will be the most beautiful women in the world..."
Q. What or who empowers you to be yourself and work hard every day?
Same as my fourth answer. I believe I was chosen as Miss CR17 for being natural, kind and humble. That is how i want to represent myself and my country.
Q. What is the one thing you can label as your guilty pleasure?
I really love baking for other people. Not really a fan of cooking for myself, but making something for others is definitely my guilty pleasure, especially when they like it.
Q. We’re sure that this competition is another milestone in your life. What is that one thing that you ultimately want to achieve?
I just want to make myself and people who believe in me proud of how I represented them, no matter the result. Than i just want to continue being the best role model i can be.
Q. If you are granted 3 wishes right now, what would you ask for?
Let every single person in the world give love to others, let every single person feel gratitude and the last wish would be to have 3 more wishes.
Q. Lastly, is there any message that you would like to give to your fans of Angelopedia?
Have a beautiful and successful day full of smile on your face and thank you for you our fans, it wouldn't work without you.
